risks: This is a record/report consistency review of supplied compact local evidence; it does not independently recompute Macro-F1 from hidden predictions, repeat private-array replay, or rehash the worker closure.
A 1024-case CPU-rebuilt validation subset from one fixed validation-selected seed is not the original full benchmark confirmation or an independent sample.
Cross-head attention/value swaps are off-family interventions with coadapted utilities; rescue/harm does not identify causal training mediation or measurement necessity.
Macro-F1 improvement with lower accuracy does not establish long-tail improvement without class-level support and confusion analysis.
Three learned controls have higher original Macro-F1 than Q here; the record cannot be used as quantum superiority evidence.
A next margin/measurement-realizability audit is a question to discriminate hypotheses, not evidence that shared-measurement constraints are the present causal bottleneck.
allowed_conclusions: The bounded diagnostic completed with the supplied exact execution and closure records.
All four donor attentions harm more Q cases than they rescue at fixed Q utilities on this subset.
Q attention changes the uniform head metric distribution substantially: Macro increases while total correct decreases by23.
Existing compact evidence can be published with the current descriptive limitation and negative/null findings retained.
